plan.summary: Hello Sarah Jenkins! Welcome to your customized FitBuddy-AI fitness blueprint. Tailored for your female physiology (168 cm, 68 kg) with an emphasis on caloric deficit management, metabolic conditioning, and lean tissue preservation. Considering your moderate baseline activity and preference for Home Workout & HIIT routines, this plan balances sustainable momentum with safe progressive adaptation.

warm_up.title: Dynamic Warm-Up & Joint Mobilization
warm_up.description: Prepare your cardiovascular system, synovial joints, and nervous system for exertion.

exercises.name: Arm Circles & Shoulder Rolls
exercises.notes: Gradual increase in range of motion

exercises.name: Cat-Cow & Torso Twists
exercises.notes: Mobilize spinal column and hip flexors

exercises.name: Light Jumping Jacks or Brisk Step-touches

main_workout.title: Targeted Weight Loss Routine (30-45 mins sessions)
main_workout.description: Perform these key foundational movements with focus on strict form, intentional breathing, and controlled tempo.

exercises.name: Interval Circuit: Bodyweight Squats to Jumps

cool_down.title: Post-Workout Recovery & Flexibility
cool_down.description: Lower heart rate gradually and initiate parasympathetic recovery.

nutrition_guidance.general_advice: Prioritize nutrient-dense whole foods aligning with your Mediterranean & Low Sugar preferences. Maintain regular meal cadences and ensure adequate micronutrient variety. Avoid crash dieting or excessive stimulants.
protein_sources: Lean chicken breast, turkey, or lean cuts of beef
Eggs and egg whites
Greek yogurt, cottage cheese, or skyr
Tofu, tempeh, edamame, and lentils
Wild-caught fish (salmon, tuna, cod) or plant-based protein isolate
fruits_and_vegetables: Complex carbs: sweet potatoes, squash, and bananas for pre/post workout energy
nutrition_guidance.hydration: Drink a minimum of 2.5 to 3.5 liters of clean water daily, increasing by 500ml on training days to replenish electrolyte and fluid losses.

suggestions: Rolled oats cooked with chia seeds, topped with berries and protein powder or Greek yogurt
2-3 scrambled eggs with spinach and whole grain toasted sourdough
Grilled herb chicken or crispy tofu quinoa bowl with steamed broccoli, avocado, and olive oil vinaigrette
Hearty lentil and vegetable stew with a side mixed garden salad
Baked salmon or seasoned tempeh fillet with roasted sweet potatoes and asparagus spears
Lean stir-fry loaded with colorful bell peppers, snap peas, and brown rice
Handful of raw almonds or walnuts paired with an apple
Carrot & cucumber sticks with homemade hummus
Rice cake with natural peanut or almond butter

daily_activities: Target 7,000 to 10,000 daily steps across walking intervals and active transit.
Take 2-minute posture standing breaks every 50 minutes of sitting.
Engage in 5-10 minutes of gentle morning breathing and stretching.
Aim for 7 to 8.5 hours of uninterrupted sleep in a cool, dark room for muscular and hormonal recovery.

weekly_schedule.activity: Cycling, Hiking, Swimming, or Favorite Sport
Gentle Foam Rolling and Nutritional Planning

fitness_tips: Prioritize consistency over perfection: 3 decent workouts beat 1 extreme workout followed by burnout.
Always focus on movement quality and joint alignment before increasing resistance.
Listen to your body signals: distinguish between healthy muscular effort and acute joint discomfort.
Hydrate 30 minutes before training to maintain cellular turgor and athletic output.
progress_tracking: Record weekly body weight under consistent morning conditions (fasted, post-bathroom).
Take monthly front/side/back physique photos in consistent lighting.
Log your workout weights, repetitions, and perceived exertion (RPE) in a training journal.
Track non-scale victories: elevated daytime energy, improved sleep quality, and reduced stress levels.
